provenance.what: PaddleX's crops and text recognition on frozen Python's working image of each of the 13 stored bay photos, with the detector's boxes in reading order (det_boxes.json's sorted)
provenance.recorded_by: M29 P5, a scratch script: preprocess.py's load_image, find_screen_quad, warp_to_rect, _resize and enhance (each working image checked against screen_working.json's digest), then the live OCR pipeline (PaddleOCR as paddle.py constructs it, oneDNN off): its _crop_by_polys, the crops sorted by width over height as pipeline.py sorts them, and its text_rec_model in batches of 6. The batches were run once through the predictor's own preprocess, runner and CTCLabelDecode, to see each batch's tensor, and once through the predictor's API, and every text and score agreed. Textline orientation is not applied: that is P6's
provenance.crops: per box in reading order: the crop's width, height and SHA-256 of its pixels as RGB
provenance.batches: in the order they ran: members (indices into crops), the input tensor's shape and SHA-256 (f32 little-endian, NCHW)
provenance.results: per box in reading order: rec_text and rec_score
